title: Four Tree Traversals
statement:
Traverse the binary tree in preorder, inorder, postorder, and breadth-first order.

Input
n, then n lines value left right for nodes 1 through n; child ID 0 denotes an absent child.

Output
Print node IDs on four lines in the requested traversal order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Values have absolute value at most 10⁹. The child links form one rooted tree with root 1.
